evals.name: named-style-scene
evals.prompt: lucid loop: a low-poly harbor at dusk in three.js. boats bobbing, gulls circling, windows lighting up one by one, chimney smoke. no gameplay, just a scene that feels alive. 60fps in the browser. use blender for the models.
evals.expected_output: A style.md filled from the low-poly lock, a target.png that obeys it, Blender-made .glb models in the palette, a running three.js scene, contact sheets per round, judge verdicts scoring Lock/Composition/Richness/Cohesion, and a final scene richer than the target.

evals.name: no-style-named
evals.prompt: i want a tiny animated room for the top of my portfolio site, like a little desk diorama with a plant, a lamp and a cat that does stuff. three.js. i don't care about realism, i just want it to feel charming and alive
evals.expected_output: The agent picks a lock itself (likely clay or low-poly), says which and why, and the result spends detail on motion and small reactions rather than surface detail.

evals.name: abstract-no-models
evals.prompt: make a geometric music visualizer in the browser that reacts to an mp3 i drop in. shapes and color only, nothing that looks like real objects. lucid loop it
evals.expected_output: An abstract lock with a 3-5 color palette, mostly code-built shapes (Blender optional), and richness judged on rhythm, pattern and motion synced to the audio.
